question: 'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: Critical. An unprivileged contract reenters the protocol mid-operation WITHOUT using a flashloan. Show control returning to attacker code, or to a second Zest call, while an invariant is mid-flight. Impact: direct theft of user funds.'
